h:accountRequirement: Official LSPU student account. It is activated after the student is officially enrolled: visit the ICT office inside the College of Computer Studies (CCS) building and have your email and password verified.

h:contactNote: Online portal where students can access their academic records, grades, and enrollment status. Reflects the same information shown in the COG, subject to data privacy policy. Accessible at myaccount.lspu.edu.ph.
h:definition: The LSPU Student Portal (myaccount.lspu.edu.ph) is the university's online student account system. Students use it to view grades and enrollment status, enlist subjects during enrollment (old students), view their Certificate of Registration (COR), apply online to complete an INC or 4.0 grade, and check that grades match the Registrar's report. The Citizen's Charter calls it the Student Web Portal or student portal.

trace.answer_for_eval:
On the LSPU Portal, you can do the following:

1. Enlist subjects for enrollment
2. Check your enrollment status
3. Apply online for completion of INC or 4.0 grade
4. Request the school Google account
5. Verify grades against the Registrar's report
6. View your Certificate of Registration (COR)
7. View your grades
